title: Nigeria WebGIS layer quality and metadata register

anthromapper.dataset: Nigeria ethnic areas with cluster and alternate-name attributes
anthromapper.notes: Exact product URL, licence and extraction vintage are not pinned.

bgs.dataset: Africa Groundwater Atlas Country Hydrogeology Map for Nigeria, Version 1.0
bgs.notes: 1:5,000,000; user guide BGS Open Report OR/21/063.

cgls.dataset: CGLS 2019 land-cover classes, Nigeria vector derivative
cgls.notes: Exact product version, licence and generalisation lineage are not pinned in the imported bundle.

climate_picture.dataset: Printed temperature-class picture digitised in the supplied bundle
climate_picture.notes: Hidden historical picture interpretation; source map, date and accuracy are not pinned.

diva.dataset: DIVA-GIS Nigeria gazetteer, transport and surface-water extracts
diva.notes: Exact source version and licence terms are not pinned; cross-border and boundary-channel features are retained.

elevation_picture.dataset: Printed elevation-class picture digitised in the supplied bundle
elevation_picture.notes: Hidden coarse picture interpretation; use the documented DEM raster for continuous elevation.

emag2.dataset: EMAG2 Earth Magnetic Anomaly Grid v2, 2 arc-minute total-field anomaly
emag2.licence_or_terms: Free public-domain US Government/academic product; cite EMAG2 v2
emag2.notes: Current derivative is explicitly partial: 90.2% sampled land cells valid; NoData is not zero and no interpolation is permitted.

esri_country.dataset: Nigeria national boundary and country attributes
esri_country.notes: Hidden heavyweight national-boundary provenance/reference; exact service, vintage and licence are not pinned.

ethnic_picture.dataset: Printed ethnic-group picture digitised in the supplied bundle
ethnic_picture.notes: Hidden coarse historical picture interpretation; source map and accuracy are not pinned.

fan_water_table.dataset: Revised global equilibrium water-table depth, 0.01 degree
fan_water_table.licence_or_terms: Free for research with acknowledgement of Fan et al. 2017
fan_water_table.notes: 2017 publication; source climatology is not pinned. Depth in metres below land surface; source negative depth sign was converted. No warranty from the source.

fao_basins.licence_or_terms: Free for use with attribution; acknowledge HydroSHEDS core data
fao_basins.notes: Nigeria-window subset simplified to 0.002 degree; whole transboundary basin area is not Nigerian area.

forest_water_picture.dataset: Printed forest-reserve and water picture digitised in the supplied bundle
forest_water_picture.notes: Source map and licence are not pinned; map-sheet and border context is retained.

gadm.dataset: GADM Nigeria state and LGA administrative boundaries
gadm.notes: Source GADM version and version-specific licence terms are not pinned in the imported bundle.

general_geology_picture.dataset: General geology map of Nigeria picture digitised into eight colour classes
general_geology_picture.notes: Small-scale approximately 2.5 km/pixel interpretation; some legend colours merge distinct eras. See the GeoPackage description.

geoboundaries.notes: Boundary vintage and licence are not pinned in the imported bundle; diagnostic reference only.

geology_map_2011.dataset: Geological Map of Nigeria 2011: digitised sheet, vectors and registration controls
geology_map_2011.notes: Publisher and sheet licence are not pinned. See docs/registration/registration-report.md for georeferencing evidence.

ghsl.notes: Thirty arc-second built-up surface resampled to 0.025 degree; cite Pesaresi & Politis (2023).

grid3.notes: Generalised overview: largest 12,000 polygons by building area, not the full 745,191-feature source or a settlement-level authoritative database.

hot_osm.dataset: HOT OSM Nigeria country exports: airports, points of interest and sea ports
hot_osm.notes: Mixed source geometries reduced to representative points. Neighbouring-country, Lake Chad and coastal context remains possible.

igrac.dataset: Transboundary Aquifers of the World Map, Edition 2025
igrac.notes: Six aquifer systems touching Nigeria; whole-system and Nigeria-clipped measurements must remain separate.

ihfc.licence_or_terms: Open research data; cite the release DOI
ihfc.notes: Nigeria map-window subset including marine and nearby cross-border measurements; source quality fields are retained.

isric_wrb.dataset: WRB 2006 soil groups, Nigeria vector derivative
isric_wrb.notes: Exact source product and licence are not pinned. Three soil groups have no code in the supplied lookup and remain blank.

landcover_picture.dataset: Printed land-cover picture digitised in the supplied bundle
landcover_picture.notes: Hidden coarse partial picture; documented as ending near 4.9°N and not a national-coverage substitute.

mineral_map_2023.dataset: Mineral Resources Map of Nigeria 2023: digitised sheet, vectors and registration controls
mineral_map_2023.notes: Publisher and sheet licence are not pinned. See docs/registration/registration-report.md and the capital/hidden-source correction ledgers.

natural_earth.dataset: Natural Earth country polygons: Africa and world reference sets
natural_earth.notes: Diagnostic country context, not a legal boundary or survey reference.

osm.dataset: OpenStreetMap Nigeria forest and place extracts
osm.notes: Attribution and share-alike required. Extraction envelopes include neighbouring-country context.

population_2016.dataset: State population density 2016 with state polygons from the supplied bundle
population_2016.notes: Population publisher and original estimate methodology are not recorded in the imported bundle.

population_picture.dataset: Printed population-class picture digitised into connected regions
population_picture.notes: Hidden picture regions are not official districts. D0451 is excluded from district analysis but retained byte-for-byte.

soil_dominant_picture.dataset: Printed dominant-soil picture digitised in the supplied bundle
soil_dominant_picture.notes: Hidden historical picture interpretation with FAO group/association attributes; source map and accuracy are not pinned.

soil_ph_picture.dataset: Printed soil-pH bands digitised in the supplied bundle
soil_ph_picture.notes: Hidden coarse interpretation scored approximately 50% reliable in the source accuracy study; prefer the documented ISRIC raster.

soilgrids.notes: WCS phh2o_0-5cm_mean values divided by 10; modelled prediction, not point laboratory measurement.

terrarium.dataset: Terrain Tiles Terrarium elevation: SRTM with Copernicus/other fill
terrarium.notes: Zoom-9 tiles decoded and resampled to 0.025 degree; not a single-date survey.

usgs_africa.dataset: Persits et al., Geology, Oil and Gas Fields, and Geologic Provinces of Africa, OFR 97-470-A
usgs_africa.notes: Surficial Nigeria subset clipped/dissolved on a 0.002-degree grid. Kl, H2O and SEA labels were supplied by the repository.

ward_bundle.dataset: Nigeria ward points from the supplied administrative bundle
ward_bundle.notes: 8,809 canonical ward features; 37 containment exceptions are individually reviewed. External INEC links are a separate nullable crosswalk.

wdpa.dataset: World Database on Protected Areas, Nigeria extraction envelope
wdpa.notes: Includes neighbouring-country, transboundary, coastal and marine features. Exact WDPA release and licence terms are not pinned.

wfp.notes: Hidden two-feature reference layer; exact product URL, vintage and licence are not pinned.

whymap_ecowas.dataset: Groundwater Resources in the ECOWAS Region, GWR_ECOWAS_SHP_v1
whymap_ecowas.licence_or_terms: Free-to-download public BGR data; redistribution/share-alike terms require review
whymap_ecowas.notes: Regional 1:5,000,000 units, not Nigeria-only polygons. Cite the DOI and all five partner organisations.

worldbank_landslide.notes: Quantitative rainfall raster is averaged; classified vector combines rainfall/earthquake hazard, keeps the largest 1,500 regions and simplifies boundaries.

worldclim.notes: Annual temperature/solar radiation are means of 12 months; precipitation is their sum. Fick & Hijmans (2017), doi:10.1002/joc.5086.

worldpop.dataset: WorldPop Nigeria v3.0 bottom-up gridded population counts
worldpop.notes: Operational modelled estimate, not official statistics. Three arc-second counts summed to approximately 1 km cells.

wpdx.notes: All 99,245 points are contained; 314 non-equivalent LGA-name joins still require source-vintage review.

wri_flood.dataset: Aqueduct Floods v2 baseline riverine inundation depth, 1-in-100-year return period
wri_flood.notes: Thirty arc-second source; maximum depth per 0.025-degree output cell. Zero means no modelled inundation, not absence of all flood risk.
